thread:
jamie (support): FYI TelosApp is seeing a big spike in 429s and timeouts for their dedicated pool since 08:10 UTC. They say autoscale isn't adding capacity fast enough. logs attached.
chris (eng-oncall): on it. do we have a customer id/tenant? what tier (dedicated/dedicated-reserved)?
jamie (support): tenant=telos-prod, Dedicated reserved pool (monthly commit). happening on eu-west-1. They hit ~180rps, latency jumped from 60ms -> 1.2s, ~15% 429s.
lee (customer-success): customer on call in 5 mins, wants remediation steps now.
maria (sre): I see autoscaler probe failures around 08:09. Metric: `autoscaler.probe.fail_rate` spiked x10. Probe queue length climbed to 320. Could be probe throttling or imagepull backoff.
chris (eng-oncall): can you paste the attach/probe logs from the orchestration plane? also check min_replicas cap on that pool.
alex (eng-platform): digging into control-plane logs. Quick snippet from attach-controller:
```
I0408 08:09:11 AttachManager] enqueue attach request tenant=telos-prod seq=18432
I0408 08:09:11 AttachManager] probe start tenant=telos-prod pod_request_id=pr-3912
W0408 08:09:12 probe] rate-limited, retrying in 2.1s
W0408 08:09:14 probe] probe timeout (10s) for pr-3912
E0408 08:09:14 attach] min_replicas reached=2, max_replicas=50, scaling_locked=false
```
chris (eng-oncall): interesting — min_replicas=2 seems low for their committed burst. do we have warm pool config? any recent policy changes?
maria (sre): warm-pool size for that tenant is 0 (historical opt-out). also I see repeated 429s from registry when pulling model layers: `registry.rate_limit_exceeded` at 08:06-08:10 causing imagepull delays.
jamie (support): customer says they didn't change anything on their side.
lee (customer-success): customer asks if we can bump warm capacity or enable reserved burst for the window.
chris (eng-oncall): immediate mitigations: (1) temporarily increase min_replicas to 8 for telos-prod; (2) enable reserved-burst for 30m; (3) investigate registry rate limits and auth rotation. can someone run the commands?
alex (eng-platform): running `rbac` patch now. applying min_replicas=8 ->
```
PATCH /api/v1/pools/telos-prod
{"min_replicas":8}
```
deploy-bot: Deployment requested by alex for pool telos-prod: patch/min_replicas -> queued
sre-bot: Alert suppressed: autoscaler.probe.fail_rate for tenant=telos-prod (muted for 30m) :white_check_mark:
maria (sre): I opened a support ticket with registry-team: possible noisy upstream rate limit for eu-west-1. also rolling a short pre-pull job to populate layers on warm nodes.
chris (eng-oncall): after patch, watch attach queue metric and `requests_waiting`. Any change in 5m? share `kubectl get events -n inference` if we see imagepull backoff.
alex (eng-platform): events snippet:
```
8:06:23 ImagePullBackOff pod/pr-3912 Failed to pull image: rpc error: code=429 desc="rate limit"
8:06:28 BackOff pod/pr-3913 Back-off pulling image
8:09:15 Created pod/pr-3920 scheduling
```
jamie (support): updated customer: we increased warm capacity and doing pre-pulls. they asked about billing impact — will this hit their reserved commit?
lee (customer-success): since they're on reserved pool, temporary warm capacity will be covered by burst policy for 30m; billing team confirm later.
maria (sre): note for root cause: two contributing factors: registry throttling -> slow pod startup; and tenant opted out of warm pool (min_replicas too low). autoscaler itself didn't fail to ask for capacity, but provisioning was delayed by image pulls.
chris (eng-oncall): follow-ups: 1) make warm-pool opt-out visible in console for customers (eng/product), 2) investigate registry QoS and add backoff jitter (eng-infra), 3) add autoscaler probe metric alert for attach-queue-length>200 for >2m (SRE action), 4) CS to confirm billing handling.
alex (eng-platform): will also add a transient fallback: if registry rate limit detected, pre-warm using cached images in eu-west edge cache (PoC) — scheduling infra change.
jamie (support): customer is satisfied for now, latency improving to 120ms and 429s dropped to <1%. they want a postmortem and timeline.
chris (eng-oncall): creating incident ticket INC-2026 and assigning owners: maria (root cause + infra ticket), alex (platform mitigation), lee (customer comms), jamie (repro steps + logs). I'll keep the thread updated.
lee (customer-success): note: customer asked also about auth token rotation possibility causing registry 401s earlier. maria, can you check registry auth logs as part of RCA?
maria (sre): yes will include. preliminary not seeing 401s during window, looks like pure rate-limit 429.
jamie (support): copying reproduction steps here for the timeline:
- 07:58 UTC: TelosApp traffic starts ramping
- 08:05 UTC: attach queue rises, imagepull 429s start
- 08:09 UTC: probe.fail_rate spike, autoscaler requests capacity but pods stuck in ImagePullBackOff
- 08:12 UTC: min_replicas bumped -> pre-pulls started
- 08:18 UTC: 429s down, latencies return toward baseline
chris (eng-oncall): good. close loop when postmortem ready. thanks all :thumbsup:
notes: mitigation: min_replicas bump, pre-pulls. RCA: registry rate limits + no warm pool. actions assigned to platform/infra/sre/CS.
